skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 900% ATK. Each strike has a 50% chance to add a stack of [Specialized Burn] (deals 300% ATK as DoT, disappears after taking effect 3 times; after any character acts, transfers to targets that can receive damage). Has a 100% chance to decrease the whole enemy team's Crit Rate by 40% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Ultimate DMG 900% → 1200% ATK. Decrease enemy Crit Rate 40% → 60%. [Specialized Burn] DMG 300% → 400% ATK.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When the battle begins, has a 100% chance to lower the enemy team's Heal Rate by 60%. At the start of the battle, obtains a 60% chance of [Evasion] (reduces Direct/Extra/Charge/Berserk DMG to 1 DMG).

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: All allies permanently get 60% [Buffer] (Reduce DMG based on Max HP). When any character acts, removes [Stun/Specialized Stun] from 1 ally (Can remove each debuff in every round, up to 3 times).

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Buffer 60% > 80% Remove debuff up to 3x > Unlimited

effects.desc: The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
Burning PvP tier — stronger burst damage, harder to deal with.
